text.text: This is my second time staying at this hotel and it is one of my favorites. There are 3 reasons why which is the price, the location and the cleanliness. I traveled solo but this is a great hotel for couples as well or a family with teenage kids. It located right on international drive and not to far from the parks. Its also close to icon park. Its a great central location. The price is affordable and most importantly there is no parking fee. There are a lot of hotels who charge for parking in addition to the room reservation which I don't understand. If you traveling for business or leisure this a great place. The rooms are updated. The beds are comfortable not hard. The TV channels are good. I stayed 3 days and my room was cleaned and I had plenty of towels. I just want to emphasize that I traveled solo so my perspective is coming from that place. I've seen a lot of couples and solo travels at the hotel during my stay but not many families with little children so please keep that in mind. Either way its a great place because of location, price and cleanliness which are extremely important nowadays.

text.text:
Aged, Musty, and Not Worth the Price

We stayed at Four Points by Sheraton Orlando International Drive expecting a comfortable stay based on the Marriott Bonvoy name, but the experience was extremely disappointing.

The room had a stagnant, moldy, almost cat-pee odor that appeared to be coming from the bathroom. With no airflow, sealed windows, and no balcony or lanai, the smell lingered and made the room feel damp and stuffy the entire stay.

The property is clearly aging. The carpet felt worn and old, the furniture looked dated, and the room had that humid, musty feel common in buildings that haven’t been properly updated. The bathroom showed signs of age as well, with lingering mildew odors and poor ventilation.

Soundproofing is minimal. You can hear hallway noise, doors slamming, and outside traffic from International Drive. The air conditioner was loud and cycled frequently, making it hard to sleep.

Other disappointments:

• Outdated interior and worn furnishings
• Damp, stale smell that never cleared
• No fresh air or ventilation options
• Thin walls and noticeable noise
• Bathroom ventilation issues
• Overall “tired” and neglected feel

Parking was $20 per day, which feels excessive given the large surface lot and available space. Hidden costs like this add to the frustration, especially when the room itself is already overpriced for what you get.

Pros:
• Convenient location near Universal Studios
• Easy access to International Drive dining and attractions

Cons:
• Strong unpleasant odor in the room
• Poor ventilation and sealed windows
• Aging property with worn interiors
• Noise and loud AC unit
• Extra daily parking fee
• Poor value for the price

We booked expecting a reliable Sheraton-level stay, but the property felt neglected and outdated. Between the smell, lack of airflow, and extra fees, it was not a comfortable experience — and we would not return.

Reservation made in January for 9 nights beginning in September 2025 (holidays).
On the plus side:
The rooms are spacious, equipped with a small refrigerator, microwave, coffee maker, and numerous USB ports. The bed was quite comfortable.
On the minus side:

One night, the construction lasted until 2 a.m., with the beeping of machinery, and we were given no warning. This was unacceptable and showed a great lack of respect from the managers, who did not apologize.
Since the reservation was made in January, they were obviously aware of the work schedule. No mention was made.
The sink drain was faulty.
The chandelier in the bathroom was missing. The light bulb and wires were visible.
The two ice machines were broken....

No problems with the staff, the room was cleaned, towels and toilet paper were replaced.

The reception and check-in desk were more than average.

Although the hotel is well located, this experience remains very average. I do not recommend it, given the other options in the surrounding area.

I used Choice Rewards points to book a complimentary night at this hotel, and the experience has been nothing short of shocking. The front desk staff checked me in on their system, but then refused to actually give me a room unless I paid a $150 deposit — even though other guests were being charged $100 or less. When I asked why my deposit was higher, I was given no explanation at all.

To make matters worse, they never cancelled my reservation in the Choice system. They marked me as “checked in” and told Choice I was already in the room, which is completely false. Because of this, Choice customer service believed I was accommodated, and I was left outside in the cold and rain with nowhere to go late at night.

I’ve been a Choice Diamond member for almost 3 years, and I have NEVER been treated like this. I called Choice multiple times for help, and I was hung up on repeatedly because the hotel was reporting that I was already checked into my room. Meanwhile, I was literally outside the property with my luggage, soaking wet and freezing.

The room is not double-booked, not unavailable, and not occupied whatsoever the front desk simply refused to honor my reward stay while still keeping me marked as checked in. This is extremely shady behavior and feels like the property is scamming Choice by claiming guests are in rooms that they never provided.
There was no compassion, no problem-solving, no attempt to help, and no honesty. Just refusal, runaround, and misrepresentation.

I have stayed at Choice properties across the country for years without issues, so I am genuinely stunned by the treatment I received here. I will not return to this location, and I strongly urge other Choice members to be cautious when booking this property.

4 Star Hotel at a 3 Star price! Excellence throughout!

We thought we were only staying here one night when we arrived in Orlando, planning to find an AirBnB, but we liked it so much we extended for a couple weeks.

Joshua at the front desk was an excellent example of the high caliber staff we interacted with throughout our stay. Always warm and friendly, always going out of their way to make us feel welcome. They seem genuinely happy to be hosting you.

The hotel itself is well appointed, modern and immaculately clean in the common areas and the room. It's pet friendly, which we love, and floors were cleaned properly, which is something we find other hotels miss.

Pool, gym and other amenities were great. No free breakfast, but frankly we preferred the option to buy a higher quality, ala carte' breakfast versus the generally bland, low quality options you get at "free breakfast" in other hotels we have stayed.

Great selection of snacks and well presented.

There's grass for the dogs and you are right in the middle of all the theme parks so access everywhere is quick. Great restaurants, Walmart, all the theme parks... and a great mini-golf course with live alligators (LOL) across the street.

Will definitely stay here again the next time we are in Orlando!

At this time we returned to the front desk, the receptionist was extremely willing to help with our issue. He printed new cards and told us they should work properly this time, as the hotel just went under renovation and the new system is finicky at the moment.

We return to our room and the new keys were dead on arrival. We quickly return to the front desk and tell him about our issue.

The front desk man profusely apologizes and follows us to inspect the door himself. After he inspects the door he leaves to find tools to reset the chip reader on the door.

Poor guy returns with fabric scissors and desperately attempts to fix the door in 50* temps. After a good 10min attempt, he calls in maintenance!

Unfortunately, maintenance never picks up. There’s no overnight maintenance at this cursed property.
The on call manager was UNWILLING to pay for a locksmith or nighttime emergency maintenance. Genuinely astonished at this nonsense alone.

We then get lead to another room to cover us for the night. This room has a rough working toilet, rust (I hope) stains on the floor, dust bunnies and a mirror covered in specks.

The time is now 3:05am, I’m exhausted and exceptionally frustrated with this stupid hotel. Safe to say my final night in Orlando will not be spent in this dumpster.

Never in my life would I think about my vacation being ruined with such swiftness.

If you skipped to the end. GO ELSEWHERE.

This hotel is an order build; however, I was very observant to see the attention to detail on its clean smell and appearance. It's very evident that the staff who work here are either held to a high degree of performance and or really take pride in their work ethics. I tend to learn towards both. we always travel with disinfectant spray and wipes. And thoroughly check the room out, the bed, bathroom etc. The room was outstanding. The breakfast was hot with nice choices and a clean setup.
Well, the icing on the cake was the front desk Clerk (EARL) we enjoyed our trip and yet leaving to return home our hearts was saddened to leave EARL. It's very hard to acquire awesome professional staff in any job field these days. The Hampton Inn has a jewel with this guy. Earl was so kind to us beyond the required measure. He would greet me every time I come down in the lobby or heading out by name "Mr. Carter this or that" always ensuring that our expectations are met and if we needed anything within his power, he would make it happen. We look forward to coming back to Florida if it's the Lords will. Without a doubt this Hampton Inn will be our location and hopefully seeing EARL once again we will never forget his acts of kindness. I must mention this I'm very observant, Earl is like this with all the customers(guest). SPECTACULAR

text.text:
Disappointing stay - unbearably loud room!

​We chose Motel 6 because we were traveling with our two dogs and usually appreciate the brand for providing a clean, quiet, and affordable place to crash. I’ve had great experiences with Motel 6 in the past, but this location was a letdown. We booked a "premium" double room (includes a fridge and microwave) and checked out after just one night.

​The main issue was room 253. The AC blower fan is completely shot. I ran a dB meter, and it averaged 73.5 dB—equivalent to sleeping next to a running vacuum cleaner. We had to choose between being cool or having quiet, which made sleeping nearly impossible.

​Aside from the noise, the room seemed fine, though the rest of the property was kinda dirty. We tried this location because the Winter Park Motel 6 we stayed at recently was packed, and this one was a little cheaper and emptier. Hopefully, this was just a fluke with a bad room, but management seriously needs to pull room 253 from service until that fan is replaced.

text.text:
Date of stay - June 2026

2 Adults and 1 child

Great hotel, clean, rooms made up every single day and towels changed daily also.

Service second to none.

The hotel has a policy of quiet hours after 10pm which was good too know as sound can travel from adjoining rooms and at one point I thought I might of needed to engage with the staff to intervene which they strictly enforce, but thankfully, the overly loud room next door left.

Not sure why the cheap toilet paper as we just ended up using twice as much, small thing really.

The pool is very shallow, never getting any deeper than roughly 3ft, so swimming is difficult, but as relief from the hot humid environment is 1st class. Brace yourself for a hefty bar bill if drinking at the pool or the bar in there hotel, very much in keeping with big city prices.

The cafe is good for some things such as pizza, but for a good breakfast IHop is a five minute walk away which is almost impossible to finish for less money, the breakfast in the hotel is meger at best.

The free shuttle buses to the parks are great, Andy the early access to the parks is worth it's weight in gold.

Getting around - if you're staying local, Ubers are cheap, efficient, friendly and plentiful. If you're planning get out further afield, hire a car for those days, but for us, there was no point as we had free shuttle buses.

Eating out from this location - we found Icon Park a really good option which is a 5 dollar Uber away where there are a good range of restaurants for all tastes.

All in all though, 4.5 stars from me, would definitely stay here again.

I would like to provide feedback regarding my recent stay.

First, I was supposed to be notified when my room was ready, but I never received a call or text. Because I was waiting for that notification, I stayed longer at the park and became extremely exhausted while waiting to check in. I finally called around 6:00 PM and was told my room had been ready, but there were system issues. If the system was having problems, someone could have called me to let me know instead of leaving me waiting without any communication.

Second, I requested a late checkout, but it appears that information was not properly communicated to housekeeping. A housekeeper came to my door shortly after 9:00 AM even though the normal checkout time was 11:00 AM and I had been approved for a late checkout. Later, I called the front desk and requested a luggage cart be sent up when I was preparing to leave. Instead, a housekeeper arrived with a different piece of equipment, and when I explained that I had requested a luggage cart, another employee told me I would have to go downstairs and get it myself, despite the front desk advising that one would be sent to my room.

To make matters worse, another housekeeper knocked on my door around 11:20 AM while I was having a conversation with my daughter. Since I had been approved for a 12:00 PM checkout, it was very frustrating and disruptive to have multiple interruptions. There seemed to be a significant lack of communication between the front desk and housekeeping staff, which negatively impacted my privacy and peace during my stay.

Finally, the café staff gave me a difficult time when I attempted to use my dining voucher for juice. We spent approximately 30 minutes discussing something that should have been simple to resolve, which was both frustrating and unnecessary.

Overall, the recurring communication issues between departments created an unpleasant experience and significantly affected the quality of my stay. I hope these concerns are addressed so future guests do not encounter the same problems. I would not be back to this hotel at all

text.text: Surfside Inn & Suites was great for the price. Our only complaint was how much noise you can hear in the room. If the noise doesn't bother you, I recommend this hotel. It's the best price for having a suite. The hotel is clean and all of the staff is very friendly and helpful. We arrived at noon and our room was ready, plus they gave us a one hour later checkout. It is not within walking distance to the parks, but the bus is very convenient and we never had to wait long. It's only about 10 min to get to the universal/Islands of adventure parks and about 15 min to Epic Universe. We ordered room service pizza and it was very good and fresh when delivered. We had a one-bedroom suite which worked out great for us. I slept in the bed that was by the front door and could hear every noise in the hall way and room's surrounding us. I had ear plugs that I could put in to block it out so it wasn't a problem for me, but something to be aware of - sacrifice price for noise. Despite the noise, I would stay here again. I like the Surfside better than the Dockside because it is a little smaller, plus the bus between the hotel and City walk/Universal Orlando/Islands of Adventure stops at Surfside before Dockside.

text.text:
I recently stayed at Cambria during my Universal trip and overall had a really good experience. The hotel feels very newly renovated, modern, and clean. For the price, it’s incredibly convenient and offers great value, especially if you’re visiting the parks and just need a comfortable place to rest. The staff were also consistently friendly and helpful, which made the stay even better.

There were just a couple of minor downsides. The hallway near the elevator on the 4th floor had a very strange and unpleasant smell. It was strong enough to notice each time passing through. I’m pretty sure management is aware of it because the hallway doors were kept closed the following day, likely to contain the odor. Hopefully that’s something they’re already working on resolving.

My biggest disappointment actually wasn’t related to the hotel itself. On the first night, our next-door neighbors were yelling and causing a lot of noise throughout the night until around 5 a.m. When I finally contacted the front desk, they responded immediately and handled the situation quickly and professionally. I honestly wish I had called sooner so I could have gotten more rest, but it was my first time experiencing something like that in a hotel.

That said, I don’t blame the hotel at all for that situation. The staff handled it exactly as they should have. If anything, it might suggest the walls aren’t the thickest, but again, the team responded right away when notified.

Overall, I would absolutely consider staying here again for future Universal trips. I’m not really a resort-style traveler, and this hotel checks all the boxes for a park-focused visit: clean, convenient, reasonably priced, and supported by a great staff.
